title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 14: Hiram's gift, David's sons in Jerusalem and two victories over the Philistines.

questions.text: What did Hiram king of Tyre send to David with his messengers?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 14:1 says Hiram sent messengers with cedar trees, masons and carpenters to build David a house.

answers.text: Sheep, oxen and goats for sacrifice

questions.text: Which of these is named among the children David had in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 names Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon among the children David had in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In which valley did the Philistines make a raid?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

questions.text: With what did David compare the way God had broken his enemies by his hand?
questions.explanation: David said, "God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out."

answers.text: Like a lion tearing its prey

questions.text: What name was given to the place where David defeated the Philistines the first time?
questions.explanation: Because God had broken David's enemies like waters breaking out, they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

questions.text: What happened to the gods the Philistines left behind?
questions.explanation: The Philistines left their gods there, and at David's command they were burned with fire.

answers.text: They were placed in Yahweh's tent
They were sent back to Gath
They were buried under a heap of stones

questions.text: Opposite which trees did God tell David to come against the Philistines the second time?
questions.explanation: God told David not to go up after them but to turn away and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

questions.text: What sound in the treetops was to be David's sign to go out to battle?
questions.explanation: God said, "When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle."

questions.text: Between which two places did David attack the army of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: David did as God commanded and attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

questions.text: What did Yahweh bring on all nations at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says the fame of David went out into all lands, and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
